note: WP4 Monte Carlo params, PROVISIONAL. No value here is measured: r_A, beta_A and alpha_s come from WP3 (runbook §6, outputs R2.4, R2.6, R2.8), which has not run. The illustrative attacks exist only to exercise the simulator end to end; their outputs must not be reported as results. The WP0b pilot attack runs (20261124-wp0b-verify-atk-*-on-spark5-02, n = 10 jobs each, acceptance counts only) give no per-step separability r_A or cost share beta_A, so nothing is read from them. Replace each null/illustrative value with the WP3 summary value and its run_id, then set provisional to false.

seed.source: fixed simulation seed (design choice, not a measurement)

T.source: denoising steps per job; illustrative, set to the WP3 workflow step count

P.source: payment per job, normalised to 1; B = (B/P) * P

c.source: illustrative honest GPU cost per job as a fraction of P; replace with the WP3/WP5 cost per job at the dated hourly rate

alpha_star.source: design target: job-level false rejection <= 1% (runbook §6); used through Eq. 6 when alpha_s is null

alpha_s.source: measured honest per-step false-rejection rate (WP3, R2.8). Null: use the Eq. 6 budget alpha_step_budget(alpha_star, k)

r_A.source: WP3 R2.6 (per-step separability), not yet measured

beta_A.source: WP3 R2.4 (cost share avoided), not yet measured

grid.source: sweep grid (design choice); p values include the WP5 testbed points 0.05, 0.1, 0.25; k as in runbook §6
